Navigation now uses typed routes, destination-scoped ViewModels, and a back stack controlled by the application itself.
Each feature exposes its own destinations to the NavHost without coupling the UI to back stack implementation details.
The repository contract and use cases already leave room to swap the data source without changing the presentation layer.
